notes: Strategy Lab now persists version-draft state instead of resetting run/profile values to defaults.
Strategy Lab now supports the full shared Screener condition surface and shared platform indicator catalog.
Strategy Lab results now include visual heatmaps/bars, preset-window chart controls, open-at-end execution events, and aligned position-evolution versus execution-log data.
Strategy Lab now uses a single full-width top-to-bottom authoring flow with a merged return-breakdown widget, denser shared-chart hover panels, and preset window controls across result charts.
Strategy Lab risk authoring and execution now support a hard trailing stop percent plus an optional activation threshold, and stop exits distinguish stop_loss, break_even, and trailing_stop outcomes.
The shared Strategy Lab chart tooltip now sizes much closer to its actual content instead of starting from an oversized minimum width.
The active shared Strategy Lab chart now raises above neighboring panels while hovering so the tooltip overlays surrounding controls instead of sitting underneath them.
The Strategy Lab results mini-panel grid now top-aligns cards so shorter panels like R distribution do not inherit large empty vertical gaps from taller neighbors.
The shared Per symbol bars now pack to the top of their panel instead of distributing vertically across the full stretched height.
Backend unit/service/integration validation and the full frontend suite passed for this session.
The major Strategy Lab sections now collapse independently with persisted local UI state, and focused/frontend-suite validation passed with the new section toggles in place.
Section defaults are now state-aware: strategies with runs load collapsed except Results, while new or never-run strategies load expanded except Results, and titles themselves toggle collapse.
The Strategy Lab results mini-panels now size more naturally to their own content, and the benchmark partial-coverage warning now includes the year in its timestamp.
The merged Return breakdown heatmap now caps visible year rows and scrolls after five rows so long-backtest histories do not make the panel unreasonably tall.
Return-breakdown cells now surface hover/click drilldowns derived from the execution log, showing the exit or run-end-mark events that contributed to a period when such details exist.
The return-breakdown legend now shows the actual negative and positive percentage endpoints used by the heatmap color scale, so the red/green intensity range is explicit.
Strategy Lab section collapse toggles now use a lighter left-aligned disclosure-chevron treatment beside each title instead of bordered buttons on the far right.
The Advanced run options disclosure now uses the same left-aligned chevron treatment beside its title instead of a full-width spaced-apart toggle row.
Benchmark coverage notes now use an explicit year-inclusive UTC-style timestamp formatter and have a dedicated frontend regression test for delayed benchmark coverage.
The Strategy Lab drawdown chart now plots downside as negative values and overlays the benchmark buy-and-hold drawdown so strategy-versus-benchmark pain is directly comparable.

Benchmark summaries now also surface synthetic buy-and-hold position, execution-log, portfolio-timeline, coverage, and max-drawdown artifacts so the benchmark reads more like an alternate strategy lens.
Strategy Lab now supports a richer first pass of risk modeling with ATR-based stops plus percent-risk, fixed-cash, percent-capital, and fixed-quantity sizing modes.

The Per symbol and R distribution result widgets now keep their bar visuals but add summary chips plus hover/click drilldowns so their bars explain symbol attribution and closed-trade R buckets more clearly.
The shared Strategy Lab result chart now supports integer-only Y-axis ticks, and the Open positions chart uses it so position counts no longer render with fractional labels.
